table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	DeathCertificateCode=DeathCertificate.DeathCertificateCode,   
	RegNo = (SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=DeathCertificate.PatientCode),
	PatientCode=DeathCertificate.PatientCode,   
	VisitCode=DeathCertificate.VisitCode,   
	AdmissionCode=DeathCertificate.AdmissionCode,   
	UserCode=DeathCertificate.UserCode,   
	Date=DeathCertificate.Date,   
	DOB=DeathCertificate.DOB,   
	FullName=DeathCertificate.FullName,   
	Gender=DeathCertificate.Gender,   
	CNIC = DeathCertificate.CNIC,
	FatherName=DeathCertificate.FatherName,   
	FatherCNIC=DeathCertificate.FatherCNIC,   
	FatherCellNo=DeathCertificate.FatherCellNo,   
	MotherName=DeathCertificate.MotherName,   
	MotherCNIC=DeathCertificate.MotherCNIC,   
	MotherCellNo=DeathCertificate.MotherCellNo,   
	AgeOfMother=DeathCertificate.AgeOfMother,   
	DiseaseCode=DeathCertificate.DiseaseCode,   
	PlaceOfDeath=DeathCertificate.PlaceOfDeath,   
	CauseOfDeath=DeathCertificate.CauseOfDeath,   
	DoctorName=DeathCertificate.DoctorName,   
	HospitalName=DeathCertificate.HospitalName,   
	IssuedTo=DeathCertificate.IssuedTo,   
	IssuedToCNIC=DeathCertificate.IssuedToCNIC,   
	IssuedToCellNo=DeathCertificate.IssuedToCellNo 
FROM 
	DeathCertificate
WHERE 
	DeathCertificate.DeathCertificateCode = :ai_code
